name: exo runs Inkling 2 Mini at 210 tok/s decode on an M5 Ultra Mac Studio and 125 tok/s on an M5 Max MacBook Pro
title: exo runs Inkling 2 Mini at 210 tok/s decode on an M5 Ultra Mac Studio and 125 tok/s on an M5 Max MacBook Pro
summary: exo and Thinking Machines report optimized local inference for Inkling 2 Mini: 210 tok/s decode and 3,620 tok/s prefill on a 96GB M5 Ultra, 125 and 1,750 on a 48GB M5 Max, and a demo of the model building a native weather app 1.8x faster than Claude Sonnet 5.5.
